title: Ramsey number R(6,11), lower bound
statement: Find a two-colouring of the edges of K_n with no red K_6 and no blue K_11; it shows R(6,11) > n. The best known lower bound is R(6,11) >= 262, so a colouring of K_261 is known and one of K_262 or more would improve it.
submission: Text file: the n x n adjacency matrix of the red graph, one line of n characters 0/1 per vertex (1 red, 0 blue), symmetric with a zero diagonal; n <= 2048.
score: n, the number of vertices of the colouring; it proves R(6,11) >= n + 1 (larger is better)

best_known.source: R(6,11) >= 262: [Tat] in Small Ramsey Numbers rev. 18 (24 Apr 2026), Table Ia; read 8 Nov 2026

provenance.keeper: Small Ramsey Numbers (S. Radziszowski), EJC Dynamic Survey DS1
